purpose: Teach: 反転/利潤/インフォメーション/呼称/ジレンマ/主たる/オファー/売上げ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業績の反転を目指せ
lines.en: We need to turn this company's performance around.
lines.style: Measured opening. Direct eye contact. Clipped pace—each phrase lands with authority. No warmth, no apology. The tone of someone who has already decided what needs to happen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。利潤の最大化を意識しております
lines.en: Yes. We're keeping profit maximization front and center.
lines.style: Attentive, respectful nod in the voice. Precise diction. Even tempo—not rushed, not deferential. The careful clarity of someone reporting to someone who listens closely.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お客様向けインフォメーションを整備しろ
lines.en: Get our customer-facing information in order.
lines.style: Short, clipped imperative. Slight lean forward. No elaboration—the instruction is complete as stated. Quiet authority, not aggressive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品の呼称統一を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with standardizing our product naming.
lines.style: Steady, grounded response. Slight emphasis on 'moving forward'—confidence without boasting. Same respectful attentiveness as before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員のジレンマを解消しろ
lines.en: Resolve the contradictions our staff is facing.
lines.style: Quieter than before, but more weight. A shift—less procedural, more concerned. Still command, but with an undertone of having identified what matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の主たる事業を強化いたします
lines.en: Yes. We'll strengthen our core operations.
lines.style: Firm agreement. Slightly slower—absorbing the shift in emphasis. Not defensive, but careful—showing he understands this directive is different.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 他社からのオファーを慎重に検討しろ
lines.en: Evaluate any offers from competitors with care.
lines.style: Deliberate, almost cautionary tone. Space between words. Less command, more counsel. The voice of someone who has seen decisions made hastily before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先月の売上げを報告いたします
lines.en: Yes. I'll bring the sales figures from last month.
lines.style: Smaller, settling note. Professional closure. Quiet acknowledgment. The tone of someone returning to ground-level reporting after a series of larger directives.
